scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (if exist gradlew.bat (gradlew.bat bootRun) else (./gradlew bootRun))
scripts.dev:backend:watch: cd backend && (if exist gradlew.bat (gradlew.bat classes --continuous) else (./gradlew classes --continuous))
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:backend:watch" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && (if exist gradlew.bat (gradlew.bat build) else (./gradlew build))
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && (if exist gradlew.bat (gradlew.bat build --refresh-dependencies) else (./gradlew build --refresh-dependencies))
scripts.sonar:backend: cd backend && (if exist gradlew.bat (gradlew.bat sonar) else (./gradlew sonar))
scripts.sonar: npm run sonar:backend && npm run sonar:frontend
